verdict.rationale: Paperspace documents an auto-shutdown feature that stops a machine after a configurable period of inactivity, from one hour to one week. That directly covers the story's "auto-shutdown timers" option for preventing a forgotten instance from running up charges. Missing for 10: any evidence of spend limits or budget caps, detail on how inactivity is detected or whether the timer can be set via API/CLI, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
